youtube.baslik: Why does earwax hearing loss seem to appear suddenly? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: When earwax partly blocks the canal, hearing is often not noticeably affected; in an experimental study, full blockage raised the average loss to about 30 to 45 dB. So people often notice the loss suddenly after a shower or swimming, when the wax swells and closes the canal completely.
